name: sj-kb
description: Search and retrieve private KB notes, capture learning and make revision-checked updates through owner-approved access.

interface.longDescription: Connect to the private knowledge service at mcp.midu.com.au using Google sign-in. Search, fetch, capture and update permissions are controlled by a separate owner-approved grant for each client.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use sj-kb to check my access, then search my knowledge base for the topic I provide.
